title: Specmatic Configuration
description:
Configuration file for Specmatic, a contract-driven testing tool
https://specmatic.io/documentation/

ignoreInlineExamples.description: Whether to ignore inline examples in specifications

additionalExampleParamsFilePath.description: Path to additional example parameters file

attributeSelectionPattern.description: Pattern for selecting attributes in responses

disable_telemetry.description: Whether to disable telemetry data collection

ContractConfig.title: ContractConfig
ContractConfig.description: Defines a contract source and its provides/consumes configuration.

branch.description: Branch name in the git repository.

url.description: Base URL for web-hosted contract files.

provides.description: List of specs provided for testing. Each entry can be a string or an object.

consumes.description: List of specs consumed for stubbing. Each entry can be a string or an object.

bearer-file.description: Path to file containing bearer token

bearer-environment-variable.description: Environment variable name containing bearer token

ReportFormatterDetails.description: Configuration for a specific report formatter

lite.description: Whether to generate a lite version of the report

logo.description: Path to logo image for the report

excludedEndpoints.description: List of endpoints to exclude from coverage

maxMissedEndpointsInSpec.description: Maximum number of missed endpoints allowed

enforce.description: Whether to enforce the success criteria

allowExtensibleSchema.description: Whether to allow extensible schema validation

strictMode.description: Whether to enable strict mode for contract testing

enable.description: Level of resiliency tests to enable

delayInMilliseconds.description: Delay to add to stub responses in milliseconds

dictionary.description: Path to dictionary file for generative stubbing

includeMandatoryAndRequestedKeysInRespon.description: Whether to include mandatory and requested keys in response

startTimeoutInMilliseconds.description: Timeout for stub server startup in milliseconds

strictMode.description: Whether to enable strict mode for stubbing

nonPatchableKeys.description: List of keys that cannot be patched

WorkflowIDOperation.description: Configuration for ID operations in workflow

use.description: JSONPath expression to use extracted ID

AttributeSelectionPattern.description: Pattern for selecting attributes in API responses

query_param_key.description: Query parameter key for field selection

arazzo.title: Arazzo test options
arazzo.description: Arazzo options for testing the system(s) under test.

arazzo.title: Arazzo mock options
arazzo.description: Arazzo options for mocking a dependency in the workflow.

AsyncApiInMemoryBroker.description: Deprecated. Configure an AsyncAPI server with type 'in-memory' instead.

ComponentArazzoRunOptions.title: Direct Arazzo component options
ComponentArazzoRunOptions.description: Direct component Arazzo options. Choose the test or mock branch and include its type discriminator.

type.title: Run mode
type.description: Selects the Arazzo test or mock option branch.

ArazzoRunOptions.title: Common Arazzo run options
ArazzoRunOptions.description: Arazzo run-option properties shared by test and mock modes.

type.title: Run mode
type.description: Selects whether these options apply to Arazzo testing or mocking.

vault.title: Vault profiles and bindings
vault.description: Named Vault profiles and the contexts in which each profile is used.

security.title: Security profiles and bindings
security.description: Named security profiles and the contexts in which each profile is used.

baseUrls.title: Source-description base URLs
baseUrls.description: Base URLs keyed by Arazzo source-description name.

specs.title: Workflow overrides
specs.description: Optional per-specification Arazzo run-option overrides. A matching entry replaces these service-level options and uses the Arazzo workflow's V3 specification ID.

ArazzoTestRunOptions.title: Arazzo test run options
ArazzoTestRunOptions.description: Arazzo options for the system under test, including Vault, security, and source-description base URLs.

type.title: Run mode
type.description: Test branch discriminator for directly typed Arazzo options.

ArazzoMockRunOptions.title: Arazzo mock run options
ArazzoMockRunOptions.description: Arazzo options for a mocked dependency, including Vault, security, and source-description base URLs.

type.title: Run mode
type.description: Mock branch discriminator for directly typed Arazzo options.

ArazzoRunOptionSpecificationEntry.title: Arazzo run-option specification entry
ArazzoRunOptionSpecificationEntry.description: Wrapper containing one Arazzo per-specification run-option override.

ArazzoRunOptionSpecification.title: Arazzo run-option specification override
ArazzoRunOptionSpecification.description: Arazzo run-option values for one specification.

vault.description: Named Vault profiles and the contexts in which each profile is used.

security.title: Security profiles and bindings
security.description: Named security profiles and the contexts in which each profile is used.

baseUrls.title: Source-description base URLs
baseUrls.description: Base URLs keyed by Arazzo source-description name.

ArazzoVaultConfig.title: Arazzo Vault profile section
ArazzoVaultConfig.description: Named Vault profiles and optional bindings that select them.

profiles.title: Vault profiles
profiles.description: Vault profile definitions, which may extend other profiles.

bindings.title: Vault profile bindings
bindings.description: Optional context rules selecting a Vault profile.

ArazzoVaultProfile.title: Arazzo Vault profile
ArazzoVaultProfile.description: A possibly partial provider-specific Vault profile. Missing values may be inherited from its parent profile.

ArazzoHashicorpVaultProfile.title: HashiCorp Vault profile
ArazzoHashicorpVaultProfile.description: A possibly partial HashiCorp Vault profile. Missing values may be inherited from its parent profile.

extends.title: Parent profile
extends.description: Name of the Vault profile whose values are inherited.

url.title: Vault URL
url.description: Base URL of the HashiCorp Vault server.

tokenKey.title: Vault token environment variable
tokenKey.description: Name of the environment variable containing the Vault token.

version.title: KV version
version.description: KV engine version. When omitted, the version is discovered from Vault.

environment.title: Vault environment
environment.description: Environment variables used by the Vault client. Defaults to the process environment.

ArazzoSecurityConfig.title: Arazzo security profile section
ArazzoSecurityConfig.description: Named security profiles and optional bindings that select them.

profiles.title: Security profiles
profiles.description: Security profile definitions, which may extend other profiles.

bindings.title: Security profile bindings
bindings.description: Optional context rules selecting a security profile.

ArazzoSecurityProfile.title: Arazzo security profile
ArazzoSecurityProfile.description: A possibly partial security profile. Missing values may be inherited from its parent profile.

extends.title: Parent profile
extends.description: Name of the security profile whose values are inherited.

oauth2.title: OAuth2 settings
oauth2.description: OAuth2 settings, including settings shared with OpenID Connect.

bearer.title: Bearer token source
bearer.description: Source of an existing bearer token.

basic.title: HTTP Basic settings
basic.description: Username and password sources for HTTP Basic authentication.

mtls.title: mTLS client certificate configuration
mtls.description: Client certificate used for Arazzo HTTPS API requests.

ArazzoOAuth2Profile.title: Arazzo OAuth2 profile
ArazzoOAuth2Profile.description: Possibly partial OAuth2 settings for OAuth2 and OpenID Connect schemes.

grantType.title: OAuth2 grant type
grantType.description: Token grant used for protected workflow steps.

clientAuthentication.title: Client authentication method
clientAuthentication.description: Authentication method used at the token endpoint.

clientId.title: Client ID source
clientId.description: Source of the OAuth2 client identifier.

clientSecret.title: Client secret source
clientSecret.description: Source of the OAuth2 client secret.

privateKey.title: Client private key source
privateKey.description: Environment or Vault source of an unencrypted PKCS#8 RSA or EC PEM key, or a PKCS#1 RSA PEM key, used for private_key_jwt authentication.

signingAlgorithm.title: Client assertion signing algorithm
signingAlgorithm.description: Asymmetric JWS algorithm used to sign private_key_jwt client assertions.

keyId.title: Client assertion key ID
keyId.description: Optional key identifier placed in the JWT header as kid.

clientAssertionAudience.title: Client assertion audience
clientAssertionAudience.description: Optional audience for the private_key_jwt client assertion. Defaults to the configured token URL and is independent from the JWT Bearer grant assertion audience.

grantAssertion.title: JWT Bearer grant assertion
grantAssertion.description: Grant-specific signing settings. Required when the resolved grant type is the JWT Bearer grant.

audience.title: Grant JWT audience
audience.description: Optional audience override. Defaults to the configured token URL.

privateKey.title: Grant JWT private key source
privateKey.description: Environment or Vault source of the private key used to sign the JWT Bearer grant assertion.

username.title: Resource owner username source
username.description: Credential source used by the password grant.

password.title: Resource owner password source
password.description: Credential source used by the password grant.

ArazzoBasicAuthProfile.title: HTTP Basic profile
ArazzoBasicAuthProfile.description: Possibly partial credential sources used for HTTP Basic authentication.

username.title: Username source
username.description: Source of the HTTP Basic username.

password.title: Password source
password.description: Source of the HTTP Basic password.

ArazzoMtlsProfile.title: mTLS profile
ArazzoMtlsProfile.description: Possibly partial certificate settings for an Arazzo security profile.

keyStore.title: Key store
keyStore.description: Key-store values, which may be completed by inheritance.

keyStorePassword.title: Key-store password
keyStorePassword.description: Password used to open the key store.

ArazzoKeyStoreProfile.title: mTLS key-store profile values
ArazzoKeyStoreProfile.description: Possibly partial key-store values, which may be completed by inheritance.

directory.title: Key-store directory
directory.description: Path to the directory containing key-store files.

alias.title: Key-store alias
alias.description: Optional key alias to use from the key store.

password.title: Key-store password
password.description: Password used to open the key store.

ArazzoSecurityProfileBinding.description: Selects a security profile for an optional request context.

use.description: Security profile to use, or 'none' to disable security for the matching context.

ArazzoSecurityProfileBindingEntry.title: Security profile binding entry
ArazzoSecurityProfileBindingEntry.description: Wrapper containing one security profile binding.

ArazzoVaultProfileBinding.description: Selects a Vault profile for an optional request context.

use.description: Vault profile to use, or 'none' to disable Vault for the matching context.

ArazzoVaultProfileBindingEntry.title: Vault profile binding entry
ArazzoVaultProfileBindingEntry.description: Wrapper containing one Vault profile binding.

ArazzoCredentialSource.title: Arazzo credential source
ArazzoCredentialSource.description: A credential supplied by an environment variable or HashiCorp Vault.

oneOf.description: A Vault secret key and optional field.

ArazzoEnvironmentCredentialSource.title: Environment credential source
ArazzoEnvironmentCredentialSource.description: Name of an environment variable containing a credential.

env.title: Environment variable
env.description: Name of the environment variable containing the credential.

ArazzoVaultCredentialSource.title: Vault credential source
ArazzoVaultCredentialSource.description: Vault secret key and optional JSON Pointer to a credential value.

vault.title: Vault secret reference

ArazzoVaultCredentialSourceValue.title: Vault secret reference
ArazzoVaultCredentialSourceValue.description: Secret key and optional JSON Pointer to a value in the stored Vault secret.

field.title: Secret value JSON Pointer
field.description: Optional RFC 6901 JSON Pointer to a string value in the stored secret.

SubstitutableOAuth2ClientAuthentication.description: A supported OAuth2 client authentication method or a substitution expression.

SubstitutableOAuth2ClientCredentialsAuth.description: A supported client-credentials authentication method or a substitution expression.
